data.body: **[P2] Reparent completions whose skipped parent can no longer finish.** This only drops the parent on terminal invocations when its placeholder remains open. In the new deferred-name flow, replay skips the unfinished `WaitForCallback` parent beneath an already-completed `scope`, then exports its callback at a `PENDING` boundary. The parent was never exported and cannot be traversed again, leaving a dangling parent span ID. Detect abandoned parents from the operation ancestry even on nonterminal boundaries, or materialize the parent; also assert that the execution-view callback's parent span exists.
